name: 23509 · Norfolk, VA
findings: ZIP 23509 (Norfolk) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23509 (Norfolk) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 23509 (Norfolk) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
